prediction_text: Winner: Donald Trump (upset). Prediction: contrary to the polling consensus favouring Hillary Clinton, Donald Trump wins the 8 November 2016 election and becomes President; the result shocks the forecasting establishment, with the outcome decided through the electoral college rather than a popular-vote landslide.
basis:
WP-004 card marker: 2016 US presidential election, asked October 2016 at a Costa Mesa astrology conference election panel, Clinton vs Trump, most polls favouring Clinton. No tradition field is annotated on the card; decided from the card's genre (mundane/election astrology) itself.
Basis: election-astrology practice weights the challenger/outside candidate's momentum over poll aggregates when the cycle signatures favour disruption; the 2016 cycle (continuing Saturn-Uranus tension patterns and an electorate in anti-establishment phase) favours the insurgent over the continuity candidate. Stated plainly as an against-consensus call, hence confidence held at 0.55 rather than raised.
